title: Context gatherer preset for reconnaissance
requirement: The orchestrator must be able to obtain the current architecture/algorithm understanding without spending its own context: a read-only context-gatherer preset (CONTEXT role) inspects the code and returns one cited report, and ROOT_POLICY requires delegating reconnaissance when understanding is missing and designing from that report.
reason: The preset is a profile declaration activated by a harness restart; the roster was proven on a second server (:3081 with an overlay), but the child's real tool header was not measured because this session did not spawn a CONTEXT child in the restarted deployment.
steps: Activate the changed kit profile in a harness (restart with ./start.sh so kit-update converges profile/cordis.patch.yml and the repacked plugins).
Open the composer preset picker and confirm Context gatherer is listed between Research and Reviewer.
From an orchestrator chat, delegate one CONTEXT brief and read the child session's agent-preset/selected and request/header tools from session.v4.jsonl.zstd.
expected: The harness roster lists a Context gatherer preset; a delegation with role CONTEXT resolves preset gatherer without an explicit preset; the child has read/grep/glob/bash and no write or edit tool; the root policy states the architecture-first rule and the report-only delegation.
